answerCheck.reason: A cube has six faces. The designated base and its opposite parallel face are not perpendicular to the base; each of the other four adjacent faces is perpendicular to it.

answerCheck.derivedAnswer: D. They are perpendicular to each other.
answerCheck.reason: A plane containing a line perpendicular to another plane is perpendicular to that other plane.
A vertical line contained in the wall is perpendicular to the level floor, establishing perpendicularity of the two modeled planes.

routes.label: Use a perpendicular line in the wall
